resources.string: A daily nudge to write, set for each diary
Daily nudges until a habit\'s weekly goal is met

string-array.name: reminder_diary_texts
string-array.item: Today\'s page is still blank. Got a minute to fill it in?
Plot twist: today deserves a few words.
Your future self is asking how today went. Tell them?
Little moments count too. Catch one before it slips away.
How was the ride today? Bumpy, smooth, somewhere in between?
One mood, one tag, maybe a line. That\'s a whole entry.
Today\'s chapter is waiting for its author.
Pause the scroll for a sec. How are you, really?
Postcard from today, anyone? A few words will do.
Every journey needs a logbook. Today\'s spot is open.

string-array.name: reminder_habit_texts
string-array.item: Small steps, long trips. Today\'s step is waiting.
This week\'s dots won\'t fill themselves. Add one more?
A little today beats a lot someday.
Still on this week\'s list. You\'ve got this.
Future you will high-five present you for this one.
Habits grow one day at a time. Today counts.
Quick check-in: is it happening today?
Tiny effort, real progress. Go on!
This week\'s goal is within reach. One more push?
Doesn\'t have to be perfect. It just has to happen.
